resources.string: Quick start
1. Server URL
2. Your token
3. Share access (optional, for the server owner)

Step 1: enter the server address. Step 2: enter the token you were given, or tap “Import access” and paste the whole message from the owner. Step 3 is only for the server owner: it needs the admin secret.
The token is stored privately on this device and is only sent to your server. Get it from the server owner and paste it via “Import access”.

This looks like a user access token (zgai_…), not the admin secret. Paste the admin secret from the server settings.
